reason: 该插件的主要用户可见用途是会话治理自动化：在 DSH 会话中观察运行指标并在达到阈值时注入下一轮建议，再在用户审批后发起交接流程。依据 README、package.json 与仓库目录中的核心模块文件，可确认其并不实现手工工作流逻辑，而是作为薄适配层负责观测、阈值判定、建议注入与外部命令触发。

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DSH 会话中按阈值监测会话状态，在下一轮追加建议并在用户审批后触发 `harness-automation session handoff`。
summaries.en: This plugin observes DSH session signals, injects a next-turn suggestion when configured thresholds are crossed, and triggers `harness-automation session handoff` after user approval.

capabilities: Monitors DSH session signals such as turns, steps, LLM time, titles, retries, and splices.
Evaluates configurable thresholds and schedules actions on a bounded next-open-turn injection point.
Performs append-only inbox suggestion injection with deterministic templating.
Requests approval before triggering handoff execution.
Spawns `harness-automation session handoff` with session/project/work-item arguments.
